# `browser-tab mcp`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab mcp [FLAGS]`

Run the MCP server (stdio default; --http for Streamable HTTP)

## Flags

### `--http`

Use Streamable HTTP transport (requires MCP_HTTP_TOKEN)

### `--port <port>`

HTTP port (default 8080)

### `--bind <host>`

HTTP bind addr (default 127.0.0.1)
